# Harbourline Digital

> Harbourline Digital is a Singapore-headquartered B2B marketing agency helping complex-sale companies win search and AI answer-engine visibility.

Harbourline Digital has run over 400 campaigns in 12 years for technology, education, and professional-services firms.

## Overview

- [Homepage](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/): Singapore-headquartered B2B marketing agency for complex-sale companies, specializing in search and AI visibility.

## Services

- [All Services](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/services/): Overview of SEO, GEO, and B2B web development services offered in Singapore.
- [Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/services/geo/): Tracks mentions and builds answer-first content for AI citations.
- [B2B SEO Services](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/services/seo/): Technical SEO, content strategy, and link acquisition for B2B companies.
- [B2B Web Design & Development](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/services/web-development/): Fast, accessible Astro and headless websites for B2B lead generation.
- [Pricing](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/pricing/): Details on monthly retainers for SEO/GEO and fixed-scope website projects.

## Insights

- [Insights Blog](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/blog/): Articles on B2B marketing, SEO, and generative engine optimisation.
- [How B2B Buyers Use AI Assistants to Shortlist an SEO Agency](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/blog/ai-assistants-shortlist-seo-agency/): Explains how B2B buyers use AI assistants to find and compare SEO agencies.
- [How AI Is Changing Search for B2B Buyers](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/blog/ai-changing-search/): Explains AI answer engines, SEO, and GEO for B2B.
- [B2B Messaging Framework](https://cleo-astro-demo-site.vercel.app/blog/messaging-framework/): A framework to map buyers and improve B2B messaging.
